description: Handoff mode from the daemon's Probe reply (`handoff.mode`). `wire_mode` is the value on the wire (null: the field is absent); `mode` is what every frontend must pick. The wire spells the soft reboot `soft_reboot` (fisherman/internal/handoff ModeSoftReboot), with an underscore. A missing or unknown value means `reboot`. Lenient readers may also accept `soft-reboot`; that is not part of the contract and is not tested here.
